subject: Different x-axis position for means, standard errors in bar plot.

messages.author: 0141b24755b40cf8
messages.subject: Different x-axis position for means, standard errors in bar plot.
parts:
Hi all,

This is related to the recent posting "change order of bar plot categories"

When I run the following code, the averages are plotted according to
alphabetic order, while the standard errors are plotted according to
data frame order.

Could someone run this and see if they get the same results and let me
know if it is a coding error or a graphing error. I have looked at it
and can't find where
the problem is located.

## Temporary code
temp<-c(rep("Low",2),rep("Medium",2),rep("High",2))
light<-rep(c("Dark","light"),3)
avg<-c(0.5200000,0.7800000, 0.3000000, 0.6000000, 0.0600000, 0.6078431)
se<-c(0.07065409, 0.05858327, 0.06480741, 0.06928203, 0.03358571, 0.06904634)
dat.avg.temp<-data.frame(cbind(avg,se))
dat.avg.temp<-data.frame(cbind(temp,light,dat.avg.temp))
dodge <- position_dodge(width=0.9)
dat.plot<-qplot(light,avg, fill=factor(temp),data=dat.avg.temp,
geom="bar", position="dodge")
dat.plot+geom_linerange(aes(ymax=avg+se,ymin=avg-se),data=dat.avg.temp,position=dodge)+scale_fill_grey()+theme_bw()
dat.plot

I suppose that I could leave it in alphabetical order, but the order
doesn't really make sense.

Thanks for any help.

Wade

other thread:

levels=lev)
